title: Unreal conditionals and wishes
summary: Imagine what isn't so with `-sA` and `-(I)rdI` (*Zengin olsam dünyayı gezerdim*), go back over a past that didn't happen with `-sAydI` and *keşke* (*Keşke bilseydim*), and say **even if** and **no matter what** (*Yağmur yağsa bile*, *Ne olursa olsun*).
canDo: Say what you would do if things were different, and give advice: if I were you…
Talk about a past that didn't happen, and what would have followed
Express wishes and regrets, and real hopes
Say even if, whether or not, and no matter what
